name: Cape Town
line: Table Mountain over two oceans, wine country an hour out

safety.notes: Exercise increased caution for crime. The tourist corridor (Atlantic Seaboard, V&A, Winelands) is well-policed; opportunistic theft is the real risk — don't walk with valuables after dark, use ride-hailing at night.
safety.source: US State Dept L2 / UK FCDO, Jun 2026

timing.notes: Summer is dry and windy — Feb–Mar is the sweet spot (warm, calmer, harvest in the Winelands). Jun–Aug is green, quiet and cheap, with whales in Walker Bay.

jewels.name: Table Mountain at first cable car
jewels.blurb: Beat the cloud and the queue — the whole peninsula laid out before the day starts.

jewels.name: A Franschhoek estate lunch, driver included
jewels.blurb: Vines to the mountains, a long table, and nobody has to stay sober.

faq.q: Is Cape Town safe for tourists?
faq.a: The visitor corridor is generally safe and well-policed, but South Africa carries a US Level 2 advisory for crime. Treat it like any big city: no valuables on show, ride-hail after dark, and don't hike Table Mountain alone.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Cape Town?
faq.a: February and March — warm, dry, less of the summer wind, and it's harvest in the Winelands. June to August is cooler and much cheaper, and it's when the whales are in Walker Bay.
